items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think the difference between people like myself; Jimi Hendrix, who had the same experience; Prince, same experience; and a few others.

ctx.x: Great. I’m finished with the Letche Elementary School. I’m in high school. That’s when I got in all the trouble with the gangs and so forth. I’m 15. I miss a semester. But remember, I was always a year ahead of everybody anyway. I miss a semester in school. I came back. Started going to school. The kids, because I was one of the few guitar players in school, they started asking me to play behind them. They knew I had a singing group and I was playing with a singing group. So they called me for things in school.…
They go looking for your tail and all that stuff?
